content.short: Multichain, formerly Anyswap, enables cross-chain token swaps across 66 blockchains.
content.description: Multichain (formerly Anyswap) is a fully decentralized, on-chain token swapping platform. DeFi users can swap a wide range of cryptocurrency tokens across different blockchains. The platform is built on Fusion Network architecture and enables exchanges between any blockchain network that uses ECDSA or EdDSA as its signature algorithm. To date, Multichain supports more than 66 blockchains and over 2,857 tokens, illustrating its broad cross-chain reach and token coverage.
